next_action.description: Find out why SeedVR2 still looks bad. The chunking fix was not sufficient: run 1 was 2x with frames_per_chunk=5, run 2 was 1.5x with overlap 8 (clamped to 2, chunk_latent=3) and Fabio reports it is still poor. The cheapest decisive test is the IMAGE workflow (seedvr2_image tab on the bench) on a single frame - it has NO temporal chunking at all, so if a still comes out soft too, chunking was never the main cause and the problem is the model/source, not the video machinery. A pixel comparison script was written but never run: C:/Users/Fabio/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/c--AI-Mpi-Cubric-Vision/973f6a88-ed27-4d7a-8b21-dc34f47da82f/scratchpad/pixcmp.py compares G:/ComfyUi/ComfyUI/temp/AnimateDiff_00003.png (source frame) against AnimateDiff_00004.png (SeedVR2 output) versus a plain lanczos baseline, using laplacian variance and high-frequency energy. If SeedVR2's output is near-identical to lanczos, the model is effectively a no-op and that is the real bug.

key_decisions: SeedVR2 and PiD become PLUGINS (js/data/pluginsRegistry.js shape), not ModelDefs - a weight that only upscales has no business in the model picker. Fabio's call.
int8_convrot precision, not fp8 - fp8_e4m3fn is only native from Ada up, int8 also runs on Ampere, and every official ComfyUI template uses int8. Corrects an earlier fp8 recommendation in MPI-506.

PiD gets FOUR separate workflow files from ONE template, not one injected graph - Fabio's call. Either shape fixes the real problem (a graph naming all four weights is rejected by validate_prompt for a user holding one plugin).
SeedVR2 gets TWO files (one per tool) with unet_name injected - its three variants differ in ONE literal and share a VAE, so four-files does NOT carry over from PiD.
PiD resolution = technique A, already built: always generate native 1024->4096, then downscale the output. Correctness needs no bench; 1K costs the same as 4K.
temporal_overlap should ship as a constant 8, never 0 - the node clamps it to what the chunk allows, so one value self-adapts to every machine. No MpiNode and no loop-node pack needed for that.
constraints: SeedVR2 quality is UNRESOLVED. Do not treat the chunking diagnosis as the answer - it was necessary but has not proven sufficient.
Chunking cannot be avoided on a 16GB card: 81 frames in one pass needs <=0.356 Mpx (~445x798), below the 0.82 Mpx SOURCE. Design to chunk well.

The chunk formula has NO clip-length term (budget = free - 10.7GiB flat; chunk_latent_max = int(budget / (0.55*mpx))), so a segment for-loop cannot change chunk size. A loop IS still warranted for long clips, but for the pixel buffers, which scale linearly - a 30s x 24fps clip is 720 frames.
temporal_overlap counts LATENT frames while frames_per_chunk counts PIXEL frames (chunk_latent = (fpc-1)//4 + 1), and it is clamped silently by min(overlap, chunk_latent-1).
